figures.finding: Azerbaijan's film directors' body in the Federation of European Screen Directors is the Film Director Guild of Azerbaijan (AZDG); it publishes no fee terms that were found.

sources.said: Film Director Guild of Azerbaijan (AZDG) info@audiovisual.az www.audiovisual.az

figures.finding: For films made to state order, Azerbaijan sets the director's (quruluşçu rejissor) minimum author fee at AZN 9,000 for a feature film, AZN 1,400 for a short or each series episode, AZN 4,000 for a feature documentary or animation (five or more episodes) and AZN 1,000 for a short documentary or animation episode (Cabinet of Ministers rules, 10 January 2025).
figures.applies: AZ, films produced to state order, from 10 January 2025
